skill_name: Think of a fiction story involving two characters in an unusual situation.
workflow: Samantha and Ryan were two former work colleagues who found themselves in an unusual situation – stuck in a broken elevator for what seemed like hours. With nothing to do but talk and pass the time, they started to get to know each other in ways they never realized before. Through their conversations, they discovered they actually had quite a few things in common. Despite their initial awkwardness, their connection only seemed to deepen over time.
